method.smoothing: Gaussian across occupied 5 mm bins within each segment; row-normalized at boundaries/gaps
method.pressure_scope: interior only for longwave; wall/interior full metrics unchanged
method.velocity_local_metrics: exclude degenerate radial frame from axial/radial/circ metrics, matching historical decomposition
method.velocity_longwave: axial component at all interior cells with valid atlas tangents
method.debiased: subtract case volume-weighted raw residual mean before smoothing
method.interpretation: diagnostic smoothing; not an orthogonal spectral decomposition or theoretical accuracy bound
